metaDescription: See what AI answers say about your brand, which sites they cite, and what to fix next.
trialLead: 7-day trial, then your plan is billed.
helpBody: This overview shows how often AI mentions the brand, which sites it cites, and the fixes that would move those numbers. The figures on this screen are sample data for the design preview.
editBody: Turn sections on or off. Reset brings back the original overview.
firstWin: Get your first win in 5 minutes
checklistAnswers: See where AI gets its answers
stepWorkspaceToast: This workspace is already set up. Take the next step on the list.
comingTitle: This screen is not in the first mockup yet
comingBody: {screen} will be designed next. The overview is ready to review now.
unknownBody: Nothing is built at this address. Open the overview to review the first mockup.
rangeNote: This preview only includes 6 days of sample data, so the chart stays on those days.
filtersHint: These filters apply to recent chats. Charts keep showing every tracked answer until live data is connected.
pdfTitle: PDF export is not connected yet
pdfBody: When this view is live, Export PDF downloads the overview. For now, use a section menu to download CSV or JSON.
shareBody: A live share link comes after this view is connected. You can copy this preview address now.
kickTitle: Kickstart booking is not connected yet
kickBody: When the workspace is live, Book kickstart opens the calendar. Right now, use the checklist, each step jumps to that part of the overview.
hiddenAll: Every section on this view is hidden.
noBrandMatch: No brand matches that search. Try another name.
noWorkspaces: No workspace yet. Finish setup to create your first workspace.
workspaceCreateHint: A workspace starts with one brand. After creating it, add prompts for this brand on the Prompts screen.
workspaceDomainError: Enter the brand domain like acme-video.com, without https:// and without a page path.
workspaceLimit: Your plan includes {limit} workspace(s) and you already use {used}. Upgrade your plan to add another workspace.
